upstream.published: Working copy of the dspace-7_x maintenance branch (92 Markdown contract files at the repository root and scripts/). The repository carries no git release tags; README.md states 'DSpace REST API is versioned alongside DSpace software (e.g. DSpace v7.x comes with REST API v7)', and the dspace-7_x branch is the published contract documentation for the DSpace 7.x series (main tracks DSpace 8+/9+/10+).

structure_note: Text is kept verbatim and NOT rendered: shortcodes, JSX components, HTML and link targets stay as the author wrote them. A Markdown file is divided by its own ATX headings outside fenced code; any other text file is one section, fenced verbatim. No division was inferred. 91 files form this one source; source.sha256 is the sha256 of their sha256sum listing, in files order.
